Elena (CSM): MedCore asked for a compact enablement day next Sat to prep for a Dedicated trial and renewal review. They want: infra lab, short PM demo, and an afternoon office hour. Can we staff?

Tom (CS Ops): Weekend OK if we limit scope. Which timezone?

Marco (MedCore): ET preferred. Proposed: Sat 09:00-12:00 ET workshop, 13:00-13:45 PM demo, 15:00-16:00 office hours.

Priya (Trainer): I can lead the workshop. Request: a paired lab format, prework video (10m), and sandbox creds for each pair.

Lee (Platform Eng): I can provision a sandbox and preload "medcore-sample-v1". No SSH; we'll use container sessions. ETA: Fri 20:00 ET. Token creation example: `curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/tokens -d '{"user":"medcore_pair1"}'`

Elena (CSM): Headcounts: workshop=6 infra, PM demo=4, office hours ~3. Priya, add a 15m perf/cost reading section. Marco, compliance wants KMS notes.

Marco (MedCore): Noted. Add KMS + data handling slide.

Priya (Trainer): Will do. Draft agenda: intro (10m), infra deep-dive (30m), paired lab (70m), perf & security (30m), wrap (10m).

Tom (CS Ops): I'll send tentative invites now and confirm after sandbox ready. Short invite subject: "MedCore: Compact Enablement (Sat)". Recording on.

calendar-bot: Event created: "MedCore: Compact Enablement" Sat 09:00-12:00 ET guests: 6 (tentative). Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/medcore123

Lee (Platform Eng): Sandbox provisioned. Temp creds DM'd to Marco.

Marco (MedCore): Got creds. Thanks all, see you Saturday. :handshake:
